p: Operating costs rose in the third quarter as the company expanded its warehouse network into two new regions while freight rates remained elevated across most routes. Management expects margins to recover next year once the new sites reach full utilisation and the renegotiated supplier contracts take effect in January.
Cash generated from operations covered capital spending for the period, and the board approved a dividend in line with the policy announced last spring.
Headcount grew by four percent, mostly in logistics and customer support, and voluntary attrition fell to its lowest level in five years.

Inventory turnover improved slightly, although slower demand for industrial components offset part of the gain in the consumer segment. Management expects margins to recover next year once the new sites reach full utilisation and the renegotiated supplier contracts take effect in January.
The audit committee reviewed the revised revenue recognition approach and concluded that it reflects the economic substance of bundled service contracts.
